name: Points West Plaza
summary: Points West Plaza is a 140,488 square foot grocery-anchored community center in Brockton, MA, featuring America's Food Basket, Crunch Fitness, and a mix of national retailers including Citi Trends, LensCrafters, and Wingstop. The center serves a dense population of over 104,000 residents within 3 miles and benefits from proximity to Brockton High School and Stonehill College.
demographics: Points West Plaza serves a diverse, middle-income market with a dense population of over 104,000 residents within a 3-mile radius and an average household income of $116,876. The trade area includes a significant daytime population of 113,000, bolstered by proximity to Brockton High School (3,600+ students) and Stonehill College (2,500+ students), creating strong demand for value-oriented retail, fitness, and quick-service dining. The center attracts budget-conscious families and young adults seeking everyday essentials, affordable fashion, and convenient services in a grocery-anchored environment.
description: Points West Plaza is a 140,488 square foot grocery-anchored community shopping center strategically located at 21 Torrey Street in Brockton, Massachusetts. Owned and operated by Brixmor Property Group, this open-air retail destination serves as a vital community hub for the densely populated Boston-Cambridge-Newton metropolitan area. The center is anchored by America's Food Basket, a 39,945 square foot grocery store that drives consistent foot traffic, complemented by a diverse mix of national and local tenants including Crunch Fitness (27,000 sq ft), Citi Trends, LensCrafters, and Wingstop. The property benefits from its proximity to major educational institutions, including Brockton High School with over 3,600 students and Stonehill College with 2,500+ enrolled students, creating a robust daytime population. With convenient access and ample parking, Points West Plaza offers a practical shopping experience featuring value-oriented retailers, fitness amenities, dining options, and essential services that cater to the everyday needs of the surrounding Plymouth County community.
